## Summary

Describe the behavior change and its user/admin impact.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests and relevant smoke workflows pass.
- [ ] User handbook impact reviewed.
- [ ] Administrator handbook impact reviewed.
- [ ] If user-facing behavior changed, both `docs/USER_GUIDE.md` and `docs/USER_GUIDE.ru.md` are updated.
- [ ] If administrator/deployment behavior changed, both `docs/ADMINISTRATION.md` and `docs/ADMINISTRATION.ru.md` are updated.
- [ ] Screenshots/examples in documentation still match the shipped workflow where applicable.

The documentation-impact CI check is intentionally release-blocking. A behavior/configuration change is not complete until the affected handbook is updated.
